newsitem.title: USA: Research Frontiers signs deal with Hankuk.
newsitem.headline: Research Frontiers signs deal with Hankuk.

text.p: Research Frontiers Inc said it had signed a license agreement with Hankuk Glass Industries Inc of South Korea to sell products using its technology.

Research said the license allows Hankuk to sell a variety of products using its proprietary suspended particle device technology for the control of light. The technology permits light transmission to be electrically controlled instantly.
Hankuk is a flat glass company with various joint ventures around the world, it added.
Hankuk will make products like sunroofs, skylights and windows for markets at home and abroad, Research said.

It said the license increases the percentage royalty on net sales of licensed products from prior levels under earlier agreements. It also requires that Hankuk achieve certain commercialization and sales milestones, it said.
Research said the agreement also permits Hankuk to produce and sell SPD light control film to a selected list of its other licensees and prospective licensees.
The Nasdaq exchange resumed trading in Research's stock at 1228 EDT (1628 GMT) after halting it for news pending. The stock was at 6-3/8 in mid-afternoon against Tuesday's close of 5-3/4.

In 1990, Hankuk entered into a license with Research Frontiers covering SPD smart windows, which essentially limited Hankuk to manufacturing SPD smart windows in South Korea and selling them for architectural applications only, it said.
